_README: Copy transcribed verbatim from project-brief/03_WEBSITE_CONTENT_PACK.md §5. These describe capability, not a customer portfolio: the pack states they are 'proposed industry capability pages, not proof of prior shipments in all 18 sectors'. Do not add client names, volumes or certifications here — those are gated in approvals.json.

items.title: Seafood & Fisheries
items.summary: Frozen and chilled seafood, where equipment readiness and handover discipline decide the condition it lands in.

items.title: Agriculture & Fresh Produce
items.summary: Produce moving against shelf life and buyer receiving windows, with packing, ventilation and inspection planned in.

items.title: Food & Beverage
items.summary: Ingredients, frozen goods and shelf-stable products, each with its own packaging and delivery schedule.

items.title: Pharmaceuticals & Healthcare
items.summary: Classification, documentation and handling discipline carry equal weight. Specialist controls are confirmed per shipment, never assumed.

items.title: Automotive & Auto Components
items.summary: Parts planned around the production calendar, where a delay costs considerably more than the freight.

items.title: Industrial Machinery & Equipment
items.summary: Accurate weights, dimensions and lifting data, before a transport plan can mean anything.

items.title: Chemicals & Petrochemicals
items.summary: Correct identification and classification first; packaging, carrier acceptance and permitted equipment follow.

items.title: Electronics & Technology
items.summary: Shock, moisture, value and theft risk shape the packing and the routing as much as the price does.

items.title: Textiles & Apparel
items.summary: Seasonal deadlines across many suppliers, consolidated around buyer cut-offs and receiving arrangements.

items.title: Metals, Minerals & Steel
items.summary: Weight, loading limits and cargo securing decide feasibility well before the ocean route does.

items.title: Plastics, Polymers & Packaging
items.summary: Resins, films and finished products matched to equipment, packing declarations and delivery timing.

items.title: Paper, Pulp & Forest Products
items.summary: Moisture protection and weight distribution, with packing and routing chosen to protect condition.

items.title: Project Cargo & Heavy Engineering
items.summary: Out-of-gauge pieces: dimensions, lifting points, route restrictions and site access, assessed first.

items.title: Construction & Infrastructure
items.summary: Materials, fabricated components and site equipment arriving in step with the construction programme.

items.title: Renewable Energy & Power
items.summary: Delicate handling and oversized dimensions in the same shipment, planned around the project timeline.

items.title: Oil, Gas & Energy Equipment
items.summary: Demanding specifications and tightly planned receiving windows for energy equipment.

items.title: Retail & Consumer Goods
items.summary: Many SKUs, suppliers and purchase orders aligned to a single receiving requirement.

items.title: General Cargo & Multisector Trade
items.summary: Standard containers still need the same discipline: booking, paperwork, handover, inland movement.
